test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/966a2df6de3d7db84b47df5ba1a8e7b3f0d7fcfaa705ac17793b358fc4d5ba9b.png]
solution:
The image that replace ? in the given series is as shown below :

 
• The line in middle divides the box in two equal halves in all boxes.
 
• The rectangular box rotated 180⁰ and moved one step from figure to figure.
 
• Circle is moved one step in anti-clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• Arrow is rotated 90⁰ clockwise and moved one step in clockwise from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f181db63d232dac1dcd239fd10866b28e74c541c98d6f84ff6fab9177059aa72.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/861627b1775e74f0860993ca87e6d37d3617123d042537351bc10432f1b9f3d2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63a0a434ef34fd4dcfdd167212776ec6ff47ffd4f0859b36518791520beb12a2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
